title: Digital Goviya Paddy Marketplace
content: The Digital Goviya Paddy Marketplace connects Farmers and Millers. Farmers can publish paddy Harvests and Millers can publish purchasing Demands. The system supports AI-assisted matching, connection requests, AI negotiation and controlled contact sharing.
embeddingText:
Title: Digital Goviya Paddy Marketplace
Category: marketplace_overview
Organization: Digital Goviya
Section: Marketplace Overview
Content: The Digital Goviya Paddy Marketplace connects Farmers and Millers. Farmers can publish paddy Harvests and Millers can publish purchasing Demands. The system supports AI-assisted matching, connection requests, AI negotiation and controlled contact sharing.
Keywords: marketplace, Digital Goviya, farmer, miller, harvest, demand

title: Farmer Harvest
content: A Farmer creates a Harvest by providing the paddy type, season, quantity, expected selling price and a private minimum acceptable price. The system also stores an AI predicted price and marketplace intelligence for the Harvest.

Category: harvest
Organization: Digital Goviya

Keywords: harvest, add harvest, expected price, quantity, farmer

content: The Farmer's minimum acceptable price is private negotiation information. It is not displayed to the Miller and is not included in the general marketplace profile or public Harvest information. It is used only where required by the AI negotiation process.

title: AI Marketplace Matching
content: The marketplace matching process compares Farmer Harvests with Miller Demands. The matching score considers location, paddy type, price compatibility and quantity compatibility.
embeddingText:

Category: matching
Organization: Digital Goviya
Section: Matching
Content: The marketplace matching process compares Farmer Harvests with Miller Demands. The matching score considers location, paddy type, price compatibility and quantity compatibility.
Keywords: matching, matching score, location, paddy type, price compatibility, quantity compatibility

title: Sending a Match Request
content: Either a Farmer or Miller may initiate a marketplace match request. A Farmer can select a Miller Demand and a Miller can select a Farmer Harvest. The other party must accept the match request before the match becomes ready for AI negotiation.
embeddingText:

Category: matching
Organization: Digital Goviya

Keywords: match request, accept match, Farmer request, Miller request, negotiation ready

title: AI Negotiation
content: AI negotiation is available after an accepted marketplace match becomes negotiation ready. A Farmer negotiation agent and Miller negotiation agent exchange offers while following business rules and using the FL reference price as market guidance.
embeddingText:
Title: AI Negotiation
Category: negotiation
Organization: Digital Goviya
Section: AI Negotiation
Content: AI negotiation is available after an accepted marketplace match becomes negotiation ready. A Farmer negotiation agent and Miller negotiation agent exchange offers while following business rules and using the FL reference price as market guidance.
Keywords: AI negotiation, negotiation, Farmer agent, Miller agent, FL reference price

title: Negotiation Privacy
content: During AI negotiation, the Farmer agent knows the Farmer's private minimum acceptable price and the Miller agent knows the Miller's private maximum buying price. These private reservation limits must not be revealed to the opposite party.
embeddingText:

Keywords: negotiation privacy, reservation price, private limit, minimum price, maximum price

title: Federated Learning Price Reference
content: The marketplace uses an AI predicted paddy price generated by the Federated Learning component as market guidance. The FL price is a reference value used by Harvest intelligence and AI negotiation; it is not the Farmer's private minimum price or the Miller's private maximum price.

content: A successful AI negotiation creates a trading relationship that can appear under Trade Partners. The Partner view can show previous successful negotiation information such as agreed price, quantity, negotiation rounds and trading summary.
